## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (96%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, second-model agreement, and 5/5 similar cases Normal [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 96%, Benign 4% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / percentile 1.0 | No input flag raised |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below typical here; does not support invasion [F4] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 1, 4, 7) · context · Above typical; descriptive only [F2] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below typical here; does not support invasion · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Slightly above typical; fits benign tissue · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: No effect beyond random removal (CI −0.005 to 0.007 includes 0); not shown to reflect classifier use. Normal lobules (0/20) is Unreliable [F3].

## Could be wrong if
- Region 8 alone scores 32% invasive risk; a focal lesion could be diluted in the image-level result.
- Image is a simulated, resample-degraded variant (severity 3); the reliability flag is not raised.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 8** — highest per-region invasive risk (32%); look for infiltrating tumor.
2. **Regions 6, 4** — least benign-leaning heatmap contributions (still negative); check for atypia.
3. **Regions 1, 4, 7** — strongest lymphocyte scores; confirm a true infiltrate versus mimics.
